english.title: Fail to stop / give name and address / report accident involving a vehicle on Stansted Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when an accident involving that vehicle had occurred at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Stansted Airport, by which

(A)_[personal injury was caused to a person other than the driver of that vehicle]_
(B)_[damage was caused to a vehicle other than that vehicle]_
(C)_[damage was caused to an animal other than an animal in or on that vehicle]_
(D)_[damage was caused to property constructed on, fixed to, growing in or otherwise forming part of the land on which the road was situated or land adjacent to such land]_

you failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the owner of the vehicle, the registration number or identification marks of the vehicle and details of the accident to a constable through the published airport telephone number as soon as reasonably practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9(2) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
